correctness.rationale: Independently constructed the 64 candidate columns and enumerated all C(64,3) triples: exactly 8640 are forbidden because no coordinate gives three different values. Fresh separately written compiled C++ backtracking searched the entire normalized include-000 candidate tree and found exactly 648 maximal size-nine sets and ZERO ten-column sets, with 238559 recursion calls. Normalization is complete by independent per-row symbol translations. Independent permutation and translation expansion gives 4608 literal maxima, and acting with all 82944 row/symbol transformations on one representative reaches those 4608; orbit-stabilizer 18. Direct profile and Hamming checks agree. This is a finite exhaustive proof, not a heuristic integer-programming report.
